info.name: CityCare Clinic API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the CityCare Clinic Appointment Booking System.

Base URL: http://localhost:8001/api/v1

**How to use:**
1. Run POST /signup to create an account
2. Run POST /login — the `access_token` is automatically saved to the `token` collection variable
3. All protected requests use that token automatically

**Doctor Account:**
Sign up with the email set in `DOCTOR_EMAIL` in your `.env` file (default: `dr.meera@citycare.com`) to get the doctor role.

variable.description: Base URL of the CityCare Clinic API
JWT Bearer token. Automatically set after POST /login.
Appointment ObjectId. Manually set after POST /book.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Public endpoints for user registration and login. No token required.

request.description:
Register a new patient account.

- Any email other than the DOCTOR_EMAIL gets the 'patient' role
- Returns user_id, name, email, role
- Does NOT return a token — use POST /login after registering

**Status Codes:**
- 201 Created — Account created
- 409 Conflict — Email already registered
- 422 Unprocessable — Validation error

response.name: 201 — Patient Registered
response.body:
{
  "user_id": "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1",
  "name": "Rahul Sharma",
  "email": "rahul.sharma@email.com",
  "role": "patient",
  "message": "Account created successfully. You can now log in."
}

response.name: 409 — Email Already Registered

request.description:
Register the doctor account.

The email must match DOCTOR_EMAIL in your .env file.
Default: dr.meera@citycare.com

This account will have role='doctor' and can access /doctor/schedule and /doctor/stats.

response.name: 201 — Doctor Registered
response.body:
{
  "user_id": "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d2",
  "name": "Dr. Meera Kulkarni",
  "email": "dr.meera@citycare.com",
  "role": "doctor",
  "message": "Account created successfully. You can now log in."
}

exec: // Automatically save the token to the collection variable

request.description:
Authenticate and receive a JWT Bearer token.

The test script **automatically saves** the `access_token` to the `token` collection variable. All protected requests use `{{token}}` automatically.

**Status Codes:**
- 200 OK — Token returned
- 401 Unauthorized — Wrong email or password

response.name: 200 — Login Successful
401 — Wrong Credentials

request.description:
Login as the doctor to get a token with role='doctor'.

Required to access /doctor/schedule and /doctor/stats.
Token is auto-saved to {{token}} collection variable.

response.name: 200 — Doctor Login Successful

item.name: Clinic (Public)
item.description: Publicly accessible clinic information endpoints. No token required.

request.description:
Returns static clinic and doctor profile information.

No authentication required.

**Returns:**
- Doctor name, specialization
- Morning and evening consultation hours
- Consultation fee
- Address and phone number
- Languages spoken

query.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be today to +7 days.

request.description:
Returns all available (unbooked) time slots for the given date.

No authentication required.

**Clinic Schedule (12 total slots):**
- Morning: 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30
- Evening: 17:00, 17:30, 18:00, 18:30, 19:00, 19:30

**Validation:**
- Date must be today or up to 7 days in the future
- Past dates return 400

response.name: 400 — Past Date

item.name: Appointments (Patient)
item.description:
Protected endpoints for patient appointment management.

All requests require a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Login as a patient first and the token is set automatically.

body.raw:
{
  "date": "2026-08-07",
  "slot": "10:00",
  "reason": "I have been experiencing persistent fever and body pain for 3 days.",
  "temperature": 99.5,
  "symptoms": ["fever", "bodyache"]
}

request.description:
Book an appointment slot. Passes through 4 validation gates:

**Gate 1 — Auth:** Valid JWT required
**Gate 2 — Data shape (schema):**
- `date`: Valid YYYY-MM-DD
- `reason`: ≥ 10 characters
- `temperature`: 95.0°F – 110.0°F
- `symptoms`: At least one from: fever, cough, cold, bodyache, headache, other

**Gate 3 — Business logic:**
- Date: today to +7 days
- Slot: must be on clinic menu

**Gate 4 — Database:**
- Unique (date, slot) constraint — 409 on clash

**Identity comes from JWT, never the request body.**

response.name: 201 — Appointment Booked
response.body:
{
  "appointment_id": "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d3",
  "patient_name": "Rahul Sharma",
  "date": "2026-08-07",
  "slot": "10:00",
  "reason": "I have been experiencing persistent fever and body pain for 3 days.",
  "temperature": 99.5,
  "symptoms": ["fever", "bodyache"],
  "is_cancelled": false,
  "created_at": "2026-08-06T16:30:00+00:00",
  "message": "Appointment booked successfully."
}

response.name: 409 — Slot Already Booked (Gate 4)
400 — Invalid Slot (Gate 3)
422 — Validation Error (Gate 2)
401 — No Token (Gate 1)

request.description:
Retrieve all appointments for the currently authenticated patient.

- Returns both active and cancelled appointments
- Ordered newest first (by created_at desc)
- Returns empty list [] if no appointments exist
- Identity comes from JWT — a patient can only see their own appointments

response.name: 200 — Patient Appointments
response.body:
[
  {
    "appointment_id": "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d3",
    "patient_name": "Rahul Sharma",
    "date": "2026-08-07",
    "slot": "10:00",
    "reason": "I have been experiencing persistent fever and body pain for 3 days.",
    "temperature": 99.5,
    "symptoms": ["fever", "bodyache"],
    "is_cancelled": false,
    "created_at": "2026-08-06T16:30:00+00:00",
    "message": ""
  }
]

request.description:
Cancel a specific appointment belonging to the authenticated patient.

**Soft-delete:** The record is NOT deleted from MongoDB. It is marked `is_cancelled=true`, which:
- Frees the slot for other patients immediately
- Preserves the audit trail for the doctor

Patients can only cancel their **own** appointments — other patients' IDs return 404.

The `{{appointment_id}}` variable is auto-set by the POST /book test script.

response.name: 200 — Cancelled Successfully
404 — Appointment Not Found
409 — Already Cancelled

item.name: Doctor Dashboard (Doctor Only)
item.description:
Doctor-only endpoints. Requires a JWT token with role='doctor'.

Login with the doctor account first — patients receive 403 Forbidden.

query.description: Date to view the schedule for (YYYY-MM-DD). Any valid date.

request.description:
Returns the full appointment schedule for the given date.

**Doctor role required** — patients receive 403.

- Shows all appointments (active + cancelled)
- Ordered chronologically by slot time
- Includes patient name, reason, temperature, symptoms for each entry

response.name: 200 — Doctor Schedule
response.body:

response.name: 403 — Patient Trying to Access

request.description:
Returns high-level clinic statistics for the doctor dashboard.

**Doctor role required** — patients receive 403.

**Returns:**
- `total_registered_patients` — all accounts with role='patient'
- `todays_visit_count` — active (non-cancelled) appointments today
- `upcoming_visit_count` — active appointments after today

response.name: 200 — Doctor Stats
403 — Patient Trying to Access
